# discord_sticker (Data Source)

Reads a standard sticker or a server sticker by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_sticker" "wave" {
  id = var.sticker_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Sticker ID.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether a server sticker can be used; it can be unavailable after the server loses boosts. Null for standard stickers.
- `description` (String) Sticker description.
- `format_type` (String) Format: `png`, `apng`, `lottie`, `gif`.
- `name` (String) Sticker name.
- `pack_id` (String) ID of the pack of a standard sticker.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server that owns a server sticker.
- `sort_value` (Number) Sort order within the pack, for standard stickers.
- `tags` (String) Autocomplete and suggestion tags.
- `type` (String) Sticker type: `standard`, `guild`.
